fields: as a router table: h, intro, cols [upgrade, what changes, requalification, downtime, start with], rows (the last cell {t, link}). parts (optional): one entry per row naming the stage(s) it changes, space-separated (pre, gen, tank, loop, uv, toc, panel); a row without parts leaves the whole plant as existing.
best_for: RetrofitPlant shows common upgrades on the running plant the way a retrofit drawing does: the existing plant faint on a navy blueprint, the stages an upgrade changes lit, and the upgrades as a tab list with the picked one's terms beside it.
